say:4:1610721001:1.text: You're remarkably clever to make it all the way here.
say:4:1610721001:1.source_cn: 你能找到这里，真是位聪明的顾客。

say:5:1610721002:1.text: Ah! You startled me! Who even are you?
say:5:1610721002:1.source_cn: 啊！你吓了我一跳！好可怕啊……你、你是……？

say:6:1610721003:1.text: Relax. I am exactly who you've been seeking from the Enchanted Cup. Think of me as... the facilitator of your ambitions.
say:6:1610721003:1.source_cn: 别紧张，我知道你从“魔力绽放”来的，对吧？我就是你想要...

say:7:1610721004:1.text: You... you know what I'm after?
say:7:1610721004:1.source_cn: 你……你知道我想要什么？我……

say:8:1610721005:1.text: Of course I do. I appreciate talent with promise. Every student here is a potential asset—but you, my dear, are rare stock indeed.
say:8:1610721005:1.source_cn: 我当然知道你想要什么。有很多学生都和你一样想要“定制化...

say:9:1610721006:1.text: Plenty of students come to me looking for "custom drinks". Few actually have the wit to find me, let alone qualify as a business partner. You, however... you intrigue me.
say:9:1610721006:1.source_cn: 我真喜欢你们这些优秀的年轻人啊，每一位都是具有极高回报...

say:10:1610721007:1.text: Business partner? No, I just want to boost my magic like my friend did!
say:10:1610721007:1.source_cn: 商业合作伙伴？不，我……我只想像我朋友那样提升魔力。

say:11:1610721008:1.text: Consider this: last month, a student of your level entered a similar arrangement with me. His magic increased by 66.6%. A tidy number, wouldn't you agree?
say:11:1610721008:1.source_cn: 你知道吗？上个月有位和你魔法水平相似的孩子跟我达成了合...

say:12:1610721009:1.text: But you... well, let's just say you could surpass even that, if you are willing.
say:12:1610721009:1.source_cn: 而你，作为优质潜力股，只要你愿意，就能获得更多。

say:13:1610721010:1.text: You would become the pride of the Lyceum, a rising star whose brilliance could make even legendary names such as Merlin pause in admiration.
say:13:1610721010:1.source_cn: 你将会是莱希拉姆最受瞩目的学生，会成为魔法界冉冉升起的...
say:13:1610721010:1.male: You would become the pride of the Lyceum, a rising star whose brilliance could make even legendary names such as Merlin pause in admiration.
say:13:1610721010:1.female: You would become the pride of the Lyceum, a rising star whose brilliance could make even legendary names such as Merlin pause in admiration.

say:14:1610721011:1.text: Really? I... I could be that powerful?
say:14:1610721011:1.source_cn: 真的吗？我……我真的可以这么厉害？

say:15:1610721012:1.text: Confidence, not flattery, drives growth. I am a man of results; I do not promise what cannot be delivered.
say:15:1610721012:1.source_cn: 相信我，我是位成功的商人，而一位成功的商人是不屑于说假话的。

say:16:1610721013:1.text: Investment is all about returns. I never waste time on dull prospects... and you are an exceptional asset.
say:16:1610721013:1.source_cn: 投资就是要得到回报，我从不购买那些毫无亮点的股票。而你...

say:17:1610721014:1.text: Then... how much would it cost to boost my magic? If it's too expensive, I might not be able to afford it...
say:17:1610721014:1.source_cn: 那……想要让魔力上涨要花多少钱呢？如果太贵了，我可能付...

say:18:1610721015:1.text: Money? That's a trivial concern. Mere coins are beneath someone of your potential.
say:18:1610721015:1.source_cn: 钱？不，我们先不谈钱，在这场商业合作里，钱是最不重要的东西。

say:19:1610721016:1.text: I offer free trials. You will not spend a single coin.
say:19:1610721016:1.source_cn: 作为诚信的商业人士，我这里的商品都允许你试用——完全免...

say:20:1610721017:1.text: All I require is a simple <style="highlight">contract</style>. A formality, nothing more.
say:20:1610721017:1.source_cn: 只需要你跟我签一个简单的<style=highligh...

say:21:1610721018:1.text: A contract? Just signing it will <style="highlight">increase my magic</style>?
say:21:1610721018:1.source_cn: 契约？签契约就能让我的<style=highlight...

say:22:1610721019:1.text: Oh, of course. Can't spill the exact method—that's my top trade secret. But I guarantee instant results.
say:22:1610721019:1.source_cn: 噢，当然可以，具体方法我不能告诉你，毕竟这是我的最高商...

say:23:1610721020:1.text: Sign, and you gain power while I gain your trust. A <style="highlight">win-win partnership</style>, wouldn't you agree?
say:23:1610721020:1.source_cn: 只要签订契约，你就能获得魔力，而我可以赢得你的信任，为...

say:24:1610721021:1.text: If that's the case... fine, I'll try it...
say:24:1610721021:1.source_cn: 如果是这样的话……好，我、我想试试……

say:25:1610721022:1.text: Excellent! Prudence and courage in equal measure—qualities of those who prosper. Together, we shall achieve results you will not regret.
say:25:1610721022:1.source_cn: 太棒了！这是最正确的选择！让我们合作共赢吧，你绝对不会...

say:26:1610721023:1.text: Tell me your name, and hand me your student badge.
say:26:1610721023:1.source_cn: 告诉我你的名字，然后给我你的学生徽章。

say:28:1610721025:1.text: One final confirmation, Inna. Are you sure you wish to enter this <style="highlight">magic contract</style> with me?
say:28:1610721025:1.source_cn: 那么我最后再问一次，伊娜，你确定要和我签订这份<sty...

cinematic_dialogue:33:1610722001:.text: What follows stays between us, as all good bargains do.
cinematic_dialogue:33:1610722001:.source_cn: 这可是秘密，不能说出口的

cinematic_dialogue:33:1610722002:.text: Here's to a fruitful partnership... huh?

cinematic_dialogue:33:1610722003:.text: The contract isn't working... Who are you?!
cinematic_dialogue:33:1610722003:.source_cn: 契约怎么会无效！你……你是什么人！

cinematic_dialogue:33:1610722006:.text: To think I had such high hopes for a new business partner...
cinematic_dialogue:33:1610722006:.source_cn: 是你！真不愧是我看好的潜力股……
cinematic_dialogue:33:1610722006:.male: To think I had such high hopes for a new business partner...
cinematic_dialogue:33:1610722006:.female: To think I had such high hopes for a new business partner...

cinematic_dialogue:33:1610722007:.text: Hah. You two think you can capture me?
cinematic_dialogue:33:1610722007:.source_cn: 呵，凭你们两个就想抓住我？
cinematic_dialogue:33:1610722007:.male: Hah. You two think you can capture me?
cinematic_dialogue:33:1610722007:.female: Hah. You two think you can capture me?

narration:35:160107331:0.source_cn: 弗朗茨试图与伊芙签订契约，但是尝试失败，随后你从暗处现...
narration:35:160107331:0.male: Franz tries to forge a pact with Evie, but fails. You step out of the shadows. A battle looms.
narration:35:160107331:0.female: Franz tries to forge a pact with Evie, but fails. You step out of the shadows. A battle looms.

narration:36:16010733:0.text: You stake out the outskirts, waiting for the mastermind to show. Turns out it's Franz—the same troublemaker from Ryeham.
narration:36:16010733:0.source_cn: 你们在郊外蹲守幕后黑手。没想到现身的人竟然是曾在金穗村...
narration:36:16010733:0.male: You stake out the outskirts, waiting for the mastermind to show. Turns out it's Franz—the same troublemaker from Ryeham.
